info.description: A flexible, admin-added content block appended to the end of a page

blockType.description: Which kind of block this is — determines which of the fields below apply

body.description: Body text (text block), quote text (quote block), or caption (video block)

layout.description: Used by the text block only

ctaLabel.description: Button label — used by the cta block only

ctaHref.description: Button link — used by the cta block only

attribution.description: Who said it, e.g. a name and title — used by the quote block only

videoUrl.description: YouTube/Vimeo link or a direct video file URL — used by the video block only
